title: The Paperless demo requires a specific installable stack, which is itself the proof
content:
The scenario specifies three setup stages. Paperless first: email integration over POP/IMAP, OCR and LLM configuration, and definition of document types, tags and storage locations. Then a Powerhouse instance: Switchboard plus Connect plus a Postgres database; the `powerhouse/invoice` package providing a drive app, document editors and an analytics processor; and `powerhouse/paperless` providing a paperless integration document. Then the integration itself: set the endpoint, configure the webhook.

Naming the packages matters more than it appears. A demo assembled from installable packages is reproducible by the audience, which is what separates a proof from a performance — and the packaging is the same artefact a consultancy would deploy for a client.

The scenario continues into expense invoicing (selecting invoices and receipts and turning them into invoice line items) and then automated payments.
description: Switchboard, Connect and Postgres, plus a powerhouse/invoice package carrying a drive app, document editors and an analytics processor, plus a powerhouse/paperless integration document.
